scope:
Run an isolated full-G1 tool pickup attempt in the existing laboratory.

Starts at an explicitly authored posture. An observed-approach station enables
native cameras and a separate visual actor. Neither execution mode grants
task-branch or repeated-reliability qualification by itself.

inferred_control.approach_velocity_feedforward: Mean commanded wrist translation and world rotation velocity over each 10 ms balance period; approach phase only
inferred_control.hand_feedback_rule: Inertia eigenmodes: kp=min(3,0.25*I/dt^2); kd=min(2*sqrt(kp*I),0.4*scale*I/dt); scale applies only after load entry in loaded phases
inferred_control.startup_com_shift: Two-second smooth movement from initial COM toward support center
